summary: Iteration 28 — UI/UX modernization pass (lazy routes, Cmd+K palette, FAB, grouped sidebar, perf middleware, compound indexes). FULL PASS. Backend: 51/51 pytest pass (analytics 16, integrations 23, hardening 8 + extras). /api/health returns 200 with X-Response-Time-ms header (1ms). /api/health/ready=true. /api/metrics returns route-prefix counters {/api/health:3, /api/auth:4} with status codes and avg_latency_ms_by_route. Slow-request middleware confirmed working: legitimate slow paths logged (POST /api/jobs 3497ms, POST /api/webhooks/.../test 1856ms), zero false-positives on fast /api/health (127ms total). Migration 0002_perf_indexes confirmed applied via mongo: customers (3 compound indexes incl name/phone/email), invoices (status+created_at DESC, status, customer_id), estimates (same pattern), activity (created_at DESC, actor_id+created_at DESC), webhook_deliveries (status+created_at DESC), timesheets (user_id+started_at DESC), jobs (assigned_to+scheduled_at), finance_applications (created_at DESC, status+created_at DESC, customer_id). Backend logs: 'migrations: ran=[0002_perf_indexes] skipped=1'. Frontend (owner demo@a1fieldpro.com): Cmd+K opens via header trigger AND via Ctrl/Cmd+K keyboard shortcut; input auto-focused; typing 'analyt' filters to 'Open analytics'; Enter navigates to /app/analytics; Escape closes; ArrowDown/Up move highlight. FAB-toggle visible bottom-right on every page; click fans out 5 role-aware items for owner (fab-job/customer/estimate/invoice/finance all visible); technician role hides FAB entirely (no actions defined for 'technician' in QuickCreateFAB.ACTIONS — items.length===0 → returns null; stricter than spec but defensible). All 6 nav-section-{operations|sales|money|insights|platform|settings} chips render for owner; collapse toggles persist to localStorage (nav.collapsed.Operations='1' survives reload). Mobile viewport 390×844: sidebar starts offscreen (-translate-x-full class), menu-toggle-button visible, click toggles to translate-x-0 and shows backdrop. 5/5 sampled lazy routes (/dashboard, /jobs, /analytics, /integrations, /customers) render with sidebar — no chunk-loading regressions. Zero console errors during 30+ interactions.

issues: cmdk-trigger min-w-[260px] can crowd small laptops (e.g., 1280px wide) where user name + plan + logout also live. Consider shrinking to min-w-[180px] or hiding the trailing placeholder at <lg.

FAB is completely hidden for technicians because QuickCreateFAB.ACTIONS has no 'technician' in any role list. Spec said 'should NOT see fab-invoice' implying other items should appear. If technicians should be able to e.g. log a quick customer note or report-on-site, add a tech-friendly action; otherwise current behavior is acceptable.

critical_code_review_comments: QuickCreateFAB.jsx ACTIONS list does NOT include 'technician' in any item's roles. The whole FAB therefore disappears for technicians. Either (a) explicitly document this is intentional, or (b) add at least one technician-relevant quick action (e.g., 'Clock in', 'Start break') so the floating button remains a constant UX anchor on mobile.

Layout.jsx cmdk-trigger button dispatches a synthetic KeyboardEvent on window — clever but couples header to CommandPalette via a global event. Refactor by lifting open state via context or expose a window-level openPalette() helper to make the integration explicit and testable without dispatching events.
Layout.jsx NavGroup uses localStorage but doesn't sync across tabs (no 'storage' event listener). If a user has two tabs open and collapses on one, the other stays out of sync until reload. Minor.

CommandPalette.jsx hotkey listener uses e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k' AND e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey — fine, but inputs/textareas inside the app can still trigger it (e.g., user pressing Ctrl+K in a textarea expecting to delete-to-end-of-line on macOS-style emacs binding). Consider ignoring when document.activeElement is a contenteditable/input UNLESS the palette is already open.

App.js — lazy() chunks have no error boundary. If one chunk fails to load (network/CDN flake), Suspense will just spin forever showing route-loading. Wrap <Suspense> with an ErrorBoundary that surfaces a retry button.
Layout.jsx — visibleGroups recomputed on every render (NAV_GROUPS.map().filter()). Cheap today but memo with useMemo([user.role]).
perf.py SlowRequestLoggerMiddleware threshold should be env-configurable (e.g., SLOW_REQUEST_MS) so prod can tune without code change.
